scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @lingma/shared build && pnpm --filter @lingma/agent build && concurrently -k -n shared,agent,server,web "pnpm --filter @lingma/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @lingma/agent dev" "pnpm --filter @lingma/server dev" "pnpm --filter @lingma/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @lingma/shared build && pnpm --filter @lingma/agent build && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @lingma/shared build && pnpm --filter @lingma/agent build && vitest run
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
